Front: The Euclidean norm of (1,2,2) is…

Front: A 4×3 matrix maps…

Front: Normalizing two nonorthogonal vectors…
Back: Does not generally make them orthogonal. Scaling nonzero vectors does not change their angle.

Front: For nonzero u,v, |uᵀv|=||u||||v|| implies…
Back: Linear dependence. This is the equality case of Cauchy–Schwarz.

Front: Which subset of R² is a subspace?
Back: x+y=0. The homogeneous linear constraint is closed under addition and scaling.

Front: Three vectors in R² are always…
Back: Linearly dependent. There are more vectors than the ambient dimension.

Front: The dimension of polynomials of degree at most 3 is…
Back: 4. A basis is 1,x,x²,x³.

Front: For basis (1,1),(1,−1), coordinates of (4,2) are…
Back: (3,1). Solve a+b=4 and a−b=2.

Front: Two independent vectors in R³ form…
Back: A basis for their two-dimensional span. They span a plane through zero, not all of R³.

Front: A is 2×3 and B is 3×4. AB is…
Back: 2×4. The inner dimensions match and the outer dimensions remain.

Front: For invertible A,B, (AB)⁻¹ equals…
Back: B⁻¹A⁻¹. Multiply to check cancellation in the correct order.

Front: The inverse of diag(2,5) is…
Back: diag(1/2,1/5). Invert each nonzero diagonal entry.

Front: The Schur complement of invertible A in [[A,B],[C,D]] is…
Back: D−CA⁻¹B. Eliminate the lower-left block using A.

Front: A real symmetric matrix satisfies…

Front: An orthogonal square matrix Q has inverse…
Back: Qᵀ. QᵀQ=I.

Front: If P²=P, possible eigenvalues are…
Back: 0 and 1. Apply P² to an eigenvector: λ²=λ.

Front: For idempotent P, rank(P) equals…
Back: trace(P). Its eigenvalues are 0 and 1 and it is diagonalizable.

Front: For real skew-symmetric K, xᵀKx is…
Back: 0. The scalar equals its transpose, which is its negative.

Front: A homogeneous linear system always has…
Back: At least the zero solution. A0=0 for every matrix.

Front: A consistent system with n variables and rank r has…
Back: n−r free variables. Each pivot fixes one variable in terms of the free variables.

Front: For x+y=3 and x−y=1, x is…
Back: 2. Adding equations gives 2x=4.

Front: A zero first pivot in a nonsingular matrix calls for…
Back: A suitable row swap. A nonzero entry lower in the column can serve as pivot.

Front: If xₚ solves Ax=b, every solution is…

Front: A 3×5 matrix of rank 2 has nullity…
Back: 3. Rank plus nullity equals the number of columns.

Front: Row rank and column rank are…
Back: Always equal. Both equal the number of pivots.

Front: For A:m×n and B:n×p, rank(AB) is at most…
Back: min(rank A,rank B). The product cannot create directions unavailable in either factor.

Front: null(A) is orthogonal to…
Back: row(A). Ax=0 says x is orthogonal to each row.

Front: Full column rank means…
Back: Ax=0 has only x=0. The nullity is zero.

Front: Swapping two rows changes a determinant by…
Back: A factor −1. The determinant is alternating in rows.

Front: For a 3×3 A with det A=2, det(3A) is…
Back: 54. Scaling all three rows contributes 3³×2.

Front: det(Aᵀ) equals…
Back: det(A). Transpose preserves the determinant.

Front: A zero determinant for square A means…

Front: det(A+B) in general is…

Front: Projection of b onto nonzero a is…

Front: An orthogonal projection residual is…

Front: For full-column-rank A, the projector onto col(A) is…

Front: Normal equations for min ||Ax−b||² are…

Front: Least-squares fitted vector Ax is…

Front: An eigenvector must be…

Front: The sum of eigenvalues with algebraic multiplicities equals…
Back: Trace. The trace is invariant under similarity and is the sum of roots.

Front: A real symmetric matrix is…
Back: Orthogonally diagonalizable. The spectral theorem supplies an orthonormal eigenbasis.

Front: Distinct eigenvalues guarantee…
Back: Linearly independent corresponding eigenvectors. Orthogonality needs extra assumptions such as symmetry.

Front: Similar matrices share…
Back: Eigenvalues, rank, trace and determinant. Similarity changes coordinates; singular values need not be preserved by a nonorthogonal basis change.

Front: The symmetric matrix for x²+6xy+4y² is…

Front: Eigenvalues 0 and 4 make a form…

Front: Positive semidefiniteness via minors requires…
Back: All principal minors nonnegative. The semidefinite criterion requires more than the leading subset.

Front: For SPD A, minimizer of ½xᵀAx−bᵀx solves…

Front: For eigenvalues 1 and 4, ellipse xᵀAx=1 has semiaxis lengths…

Front: In Doolittle LU, the diagonal of L contains…

Front: For a fixed dense A and many b values, prefer…

Front: Singular values are square roots of eigenvalues of…

Front: Rank equals the number of…

Front: For diag(−3,2), singular values are…
Back: 3,2. They are nonnegative square roots of 9 and 4.

Front: For singular values 5,3,1, rank-one squared Frobenius error is…
Back: 10. Sum squares of discarded singular values: 3²+1².

Front: Before interpreting SVD as covariance PCA, usually…
Back: Center feature columns. PCA variation is measured about the mean; scaling is a separate choice.
